messages:
sam: Heads-up — ran a quick smoke on runtime docs and hit a 404.
The code example in /docs/runtime/new-session references https://gist.github.com/old/abcdef which now returns 404. Not sure who owns that page.

olivia: Ugh, thanks for flagging. I think that page was migrated ages ago. Was the gist used to show a multipart auth sample?

sam: yeah, it's the multipart example block around the 'session-init' section. Link checker in CI missed it because it's external.

jake: I can take this. Suggest we inline the snippet into the doc and add a small note attributing the gist instead of linking.

olivia: +1. Inline is safer. If you're doing the PR, can you also add a quick unit for the docs link-checker to blacklist external gist URLs? We've hit these before.

jake: Plan: 1) replace the external link with a fenced code block (copy the gist contents); 2) update frontmatter with `link_policy: local-preferred`; 3) add a regex to the link-checker config to catch `gist.github.com` next run.

kb-bot: docs-link-scan: New scan found 1 external-gist link in /docs/runtime/new-session — ticket #DOCS-452 created.

lina: FYI if you inline the snippet, please keep the original license header (if any) and run `make docs-build` locally to ensure no render break.

jake: Will do. Quick draft commands for reviewers:
```
# replace gist link with inline snippet
sed -n '1,200p' examples/session-init.gist > docs/runtime/new-session.md
# update frontmatter
python -c "import frontmatter,sys; m=frontmatter.load('docs/runtime/new-session.md'); m['link_policy']='local-preferred'; frontmatter.dump(m,open('docs/runtime/new-session.md','w'))"
```

sam: Awesome — thanks. If you want, I can also open a tiny follow-up PR to the link-checker config so we don't miss these next time.

jake: I'll open the doc PR now, include the snippet and license header. Tagging @olivia for review.

olivia: Thanks! If PR touches the frontmatter linting rule ping me, otherwise I'll review the content change.

sam: marking as resolved for the smoke test — will re-run after PR lands :thumbsup:

jake: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/-/merge_requests/412 — includes snippet + CI fix stub. @lina can you sanity-check the build step?

lina: Quick look — builds locally for me. CI should be green once the small link-checker tweak lands.

sam: Verified after merge, no more 404 on that page. Closing the loop. :tada:
